test_path_middleware_rewrites_through_deep_agent: exercises create_deep_agent directly with PathNormalizationMiddleware; confirms /Users/dev/project/src/main.py rewrites to /src/main.py

Key discovery: _MockTool (plain Python, not BaseTool) is incompatible with create_deep_agent — SubAgentMiddleware internally creates ToolNode which requires BaseTool instances. Used StructuredTool.from_function instead.

Key discovery: StructuredTool with no declared schema fields triggers a short-circuit in _to_args_and_kwargs that passes **{} to the coroutine; call count assertions still work correctly. For value assertions (test 2) the coroutine declares file_path: str so LangChain infers a proper schema.
Both tests pass; full existing suite (1093 tests) still green; ruff lint clean.

comments.note: helpers/mock_tools.py._MockTool is not a BaseTool subclass. Any future test that calls create_deep_agent with _MockTool will fail with ValueError in SubAgentMiddleware. Consider adding a note to mock_tools.py documenting this limitation for contributors writing integration tests.

test 2 uses LocalShellBackend(root_dir=None) without specifying virtual_mode, which generates a DeprecationWarning about the default changing in deepagents 0.5.0. If/when the library is upgraded, consider adding virtual_mode=False explicitly to suppress the warning.

The _AnyArgsSchema helper (empty Pydantic model with extra='allow') silently swallows all args due to _to_args_and_kwargs short-circuit. This is acceptable for count-only assertions but could be confusing for maintainers — the docstring explains the behaviour clearly.
